function.name: decide_action
function.description: Approve or cancel an action waiting for the caller's approval. On a confirmation call (Alo already read the action aloud) pass decision + the PIN. On any other call, calling it without a decision makes Alo call the caller back to read the pending action.

decision.description: approve = send/create it; reject = cancel it.

pin.description: The caller's 6-digit PIN, digits only. Required to approve.
